text: Skeb/Pixiv Request/Commission Support General Previous thread: >>8893195 This thread is for discussions about commissioning non-Western (primarily Japanese) artists through platforms such as Skeb, Pixiv, Fantia, and similar sites. Feel free to ask questions and recommendations for specific kinks/fetishes. >Skeb (requires a Twitter/X, Bluesky, VRChat, or Misskey account) https://skeb.jp >Skeb Button/Skebify https://chrome.google.com/webstore/ detail/skeb-button/onjegdbehgoamaio chjfnkokondpgoim https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/fi refox/addon/skebify/ (Outdated) Displays on Twitter/X whether an artist has a Skeb account and is currently accepting requests. >SkebUe - Memo Box https://github.com/numasuke/skebue_ memo (Removed from webstore) Allows you to write notes on an artist's Skeb page. >Skeb Pricing Manager https://greasyfork.org/en/scripts/4 64685-skeb-pricing-manager Retrieves prices, deadlines, and completion rates for both open and closed artists. The price for closed artists will be the price when last open. >It's not loading any data! You need to manually navigate to the artist's Skeb page. Directly opening the page or refreshing won't work. >Skeb Price Sorter https://greasyfork.org/en/scripts/4 60083-skeb-price-sorter Allows you to sort artists by recommended price. Do not use on a large amount of artists at the same time or you will get timed out for too many requests. >How to check the Request ID on Skeb https://pastebin.com/AP4yxSad >Pixiv Request https://www.pixiv.net/request >Help! I can’t request R18/R18G because of my payment method! Change your UI language to Japanese, and you should be able to. >Help! Requests cannot be made from my region! Change your country to Japan, and you should be able to. >Fantia Commissions https://fantia.jp/commissions/ These commissions are reserved for supporters, but artists may allow those in the free plan to request too. Skeb/Pixiv Request/Commission Support General OP Pastebin (Use if making new thread): https://pastebin.com/rPH6ZPqs
